results.title: Betty
results.overview: Dr. Joseph Banta embarks on a self-proclaimed mission to save the world, aided by his A.I. servant, Betty, designed to fulfill his unconventional desires and execute his mission to rid the world of evil, regardless of the grim outcome.

results.title: Jane Austen Wrecked My Life
results.original_title: Jane Austen a gâché ma vie
results.overview: An aspiring author looking to get more out of life takes up a writing residency and finds herself in the sort of romantic entanglements that could come from the pages of a Jane Austen novel.

results.original_title: German Horror Story - Teutonic Terror Tales

results.title: Pedestrian
results.overview: A young man, on-edge, tries cycling as a way to make friends.

results.title: Christmas For The Soul
results.overview: Leslie, a soul food chef at Papa's Cafe, receives a special invitation to cook Christmas Dinner for the Shaws, a wealthy family aiming to buy up her neighborhood. When the CEO, Justin Shaw, goes missing, family feuds erupt over his successor leaving Leslie, the pregnant chef's caught in the middle of the Shaw's dysfunctional Christmas family feud.

results.title: Intimate Apparel
results.overview: Two buddies attempt to keep their lingerie store afloat by running an App-based male escort service.

results.title: Nobody Cares
results.overview: Today, loneliness is the most common feeling in the world. Danny, living alone in his 30s and searching for connection, goes to the last place he thought he would end up - an orgy.

results.title: La vie dans les bois - D'après "Walden" de Henry David Thoreau
results.original_title: La vie dans les bois - D'après "Walden" de Henry David Thoreau
results.overview: An exploration of Walden, or Life in the Woods, the seminal work by writer and philosopher Henry David Thoreau (1817–1862), a major inspiration for modern environmentalist thinking.

results.title: Sound of Silence
results.overview: Lawyer Li Qi, driven by greed, becomes embroiled in a fraud case against deaf individuals, abandoning his deaf family background in pursuit of fame and fortune.

results.title: Eavesdropping
results.overview: After receiving a significant settlement following a workplace accident, Pablo decides to invest all the money he had promised to use for building a new life with his girlfriend, Victoria, into a business he knows little about. Together, they must deal with the consequences of this impulsive decision.

results.title: Jetzt. Wohin. - Meine Reise mit Robert Habeck
results.original_title: Jetzt. Wohin. - Meine Reise mit Robert Habeck
results.overview: Lars Jessen accompanies Robert Habeck during the 2025 federal election campaign and talks to companions from all phases of Habeck's life. He examines the question of how politics functions in the current era and in the context of the eruption of democratic systems.

results.title: Doğulu
results.overview: After being released from prison, where they had been incarcerated for many years, Fırat Doğulu and his companion Akın find themselves embroiled in a relentless quest for revenge.

results.title: The Strike
results.overview: Through the editing of archive footage and a reading of Ovidie's La Chair est triste hélas, Gabrielle Stemmer's collage film shatters the heterosexual model, a story that is both intimate and political.

results.title: NJPW World Tag League 2025 - Day 17 (Final)
results.overview: The seventeenth and final night of New Japan Pro-Wrestling's annual heavyweight tag team tournament took place on December 14, 2025, at Grand Messe Kumamoto in Mashiki, Kumamoto, Japan, and featured the match to crown the winners of World Tag League 2025.

results.title: Same Day with Someone
results.original_title: ซ้ำวัน กับ Someone
results.overview: Trapped in a time loop, a picture-perfect museum curator relives her worst day ever and must figure out how to break free from the vicious cycle.

results.title: Violent Ends
results.overview: A man raised in a violent crime family struggles to build an honest life with his fiancée but is dragged back into the criminal world after his cousin’s armed robbery leaves an innocent person caught in the crossfire.

results.title: WEST
results.overview: Breakdance collective 155 rides from Utrecht (Netherlands) to Accra (Ghana, Africa) together with their motorcycle crew. 10,000 km of asphalt, reflection, art-making, and survival. Escaping the grind at home, riding into the unknown, chasing inspiration and fresh perspectives.  This short dance film explores the parallel between being deep in a journey — overwhelmed by new impressions, unable to fully process or make sense of them — and the ability to express all of that through movement. The memories are stored not through thought, but through motion. It’s a tough ride that slowly reveals how much we take for granted, how dance speaks across all borders, and how the most instinctive, unplanned creations often become the most honest ones

results.title: Terror Night
results.overview: Josefin has installed the fattest bass box in her EPA and rolls out to impress her crush, Billy. But when the subculture with the thundering bass passages meets a sound-sensitive adult world with sleep problems, it goes haywire and degenerates into blood whiteness.

results.title: Nocturnal
results.overview: Min-tae, a once-notorious gangster who now leads a peaceful retired life, discovers the bloody corpse of his only next of kin: his younger brother Seok-tae. With his brother’s missing wife Moon-young as the prime suspect, Min-tae uncovers a suspicious last phone call between her and a mysterious novelist, sparking a vicious hunt for the truth despite his seemingly deceitful former crime syndicate and the police in hot pursuit.
